fullDescription: A dark-themed, condensed SaaS wizard interface designed for high-density technical configurations like machine learning settings or fintech dashboards. Features a multi-step sidebar navigation, a top-aligned progress bar, and streamlined selection rows. The style utilizes a sophisticated palette of deep charcoal, slate grays, and a signature orange accent (#e37400) to highlight primary actions and active states. Typography is set in Inter for maximum legibility at small sizes, employing a precise hierarchy with metadata separated by em-dashes and uppercase section headers.
prompt:
## Resumo
A professional, high-density configuration dialog with a sidebar-driven wizard layout, featuring condensed selection rows, inline slider controls, and a subtle dark-mode aesthetic with orange primary accents.

## Estilo Visual
Create a dark-mode technical UI using a 'Black and Orange' palette. Backgrounds: deep black-900 (#151517) for the main page and gray-900 (#212121) for the main dialog. Accent Color: orange-900 (#e37400) for primary buttons and active indicators. Typography: Font-family 'Inter', sans-serif. Headings: 16px/bold/white. Secondary text: 14px/gray-400. Metadata: 12px/gray-500. Borders: 1px solid #424242 (gray-800). Animation: 200ms ease-in-out transition for hover states on buttons and navigation items. Buttons: Primary buttons use #e37400 with white text; secondary buttons use transparent backgrounds with gray-800 borders and 10px bold uppercase labels.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Top Progress Bar
Include a full-width 3px high progress bar container at the top of the dialog using #424242. The active progress should be a solid bar of #e37400 (orange-900) reflecting the current step percentage.

### Wizard Sidebar
Width: 240px. Background: #151517 (semi-transparent 60%). Padding: 16px. Steps consist of buttons with 24px circular icons. Completed steps: Green-600 circle with white checkmark. Current step: Orange-900 circle with white number. Future steps: Gray-600 circle with gray-300 number. Labels: 13px medium Inter.

### Content Header & Info Banner
Header: 16px bold title with 14px gray-400 subtitle. Below the header, include an info banner with a #2c67d0/20 background (blue-950/20) and a 1px #2c67d0/40 border. Banner text: 12px blue-400 with a bold prefix 'Default if skipped:'.

### Condensed Selection Rows
List of options as full-width clickable rows. Layout: 14px height radio circle (3.5 units), title in 14px medium white, then an em-dash (—) followed by a 14px regular gray-500 description. Rows should have 6px padding and a subtle hover highlight of gray-800/50. Selected row: Orange-900 radio background with a white dot and 10% orange tint background for the entire row.

### Inline Slider Section
Section with a 12px bold uppercase header. Below, a row containing a 'Window Size' label (14px gray-400, 96px fixed width) and a horizontal range slider. Slider track: 4px height, gray-800. Slider thumb: 12px diameter, solid #e37400. Value display: 14px bold orange-900 at the end of the row.

### Dialog Footer
Height: 72px. Border-top: 1px gray-800. Background: #212121. Left side: Group of 'Back' and 'Cancel' buttons (10px bold, gray-400, bordered) and a 'Skip' button (gray-500, no border). Right side: 'Continue' primary button in solid #e37400 with white text, 11px bold, 24px horizontal padding.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Condensed Radio Selection Row — A highly efficient list item for choosing options without clutter.
Create a list of horizontal items. Each item is a `<button>` or `<div>` with `flex items-center gap-3`. The radio indicator is a `div` of `14px x 14px` with a `1px` border of `gray-600`. When active, it becomes `bg-orange-900` with a `6px` white circle inside. The text content follows: `[Title] [em-dash] [Description in gray-500]`. Add a `transition-all` hover state that applies `bg-gray-800/50`.

### Minimalist Accent Slider — An inline range input optimized for dark UI.
Implement a range input (`type='range'`) with a custom thumb. `track-height: 4px`, `track-bg: #424242`. `thumb-size: 12px`, `thumb-bg: #e37400`, `thumb-radius: 50%`. The slider should be preceded by a label and followed by its current value in orange-900 bold text.

## Notas Especiais
MUST: Maintain a strict 1px border grid. Use #e37400 for all primary interaction cues. Use gray-500 (#9E9E9E) for all secondary descriptive text to maintain hierarchy. MUST NOT: Use cards or bordered containers for individual selection items; they must be condensed rows to save vertical space. DO NOT: Use font sizes larger than 16px.

style.description: The design follows a strict 'Dark/Technical' aesthetic. Typography uses the Inter sans-serif family with a range of weights (400 to 700). Colors are anchored by a black-900 background (#151517) and gray-900 containers (#212121). Primary accents use a warm orange-900 (#e37400) for progress and primary buttons. Borders are subtle (gray-800), and interactions favor soft background shifts (gray-800/50) rather than heavy shadows or borders.
